attempted_cash_pool_rollforward.finding: No separately bound beginning/end bank-overdraft balance and complete noncash/FX bridge was recovered in the reviewed annual/quarterly primary bodies. decisions.original_error_or_limit: Expensed, capitalized, accrued, and paid interest are different populations. Treating disclosed capitalized interest as an automatic FCFF cash add-back would mix accounting and cash amounts and could duplicate investment adjustments.
decisions.treatment_applied: Built a five-year schedule preserving total consolidated expensed interest23/185/446/715/1165M; disclosed incurred capitalized interest is283/384/535M for FY2023/24/25, with FY2021/22 unbound rather than zero. Separately bound cash interest net of capitalized interest0/0/448/486/696M from the disclosed comparative table. The explicit early cash-interest zeros are reported values, not absence fills.
decisions.classification_policy: Retain the current reported-CFO plus after-tax EXPENSED-interest historical convention. Capitalized-interest cash, if separately recovered, belongs in investing cash under USGAAP ASC230 and must be reconciled to the cash investment perimeter. Incurred capitalized cost is not necessarily paid capitalized interest. Interest capitalized into assets can also produce later amortization and tax effects; the historical reported ETR is not an observed interest shield.
decisions.source_reference: KPMG Statement of Cash Flows handbook section8.5.20, printedpage108, interpreting ASC230-10-45-13(c),45-17(d),50-12. This is classification guidance, not issuer amount evidence.
rejected_inferences: Do not add283/384/535M mechanically to FCFF.
Do not add notes-only interest again to the consolidated expensed-interest line. Notes-only values are a subset, can be rounded and do not completely decompose consolidated expense.
Do not infer actual capitalized-interest cash from expensed minus paid interest; accruals and noncash financing-cost amortization can differ.
Do not erase current historical FCFF merely because an alternative broader unlevered comparison remains unresolved. Keep its exact convention label.
